description: This test ensures that users can navigate to the Documentation page from the footer of the login page.
steps: Navigate to the login page at https://dev.roost.ai/login.
Scroll to the footer section of the page.
Locate the 'Documentation' link using the provided stable selector.
Ensure the browser is redirected to https://docs.roost.ai.
Verify that the Documentation page loads successfully by checking for specific content unique to that page.
expected_results: User can see the 'Documentation' link in the footer.
Clicking the link redirects the user to the Documentation page.
The Documentation page loads successfully with relevant content.
edge_cases: The 'Documentation' link is not visible due to a rendering issue.
User clicks the link, but the browser blocks the navigation (e.g., popup blocker).
The Documentation page loads with a delay.
Network latency causes the page to load incompletely.
data_requirements: Valid URL for the Documentation page.
Test content on the Documentation page for verification.
Browser cache cleared to test fresh loading.
dependencies: Footer section visibility on the login page.
api_interactions: GET requests for assets required by the Documentation page.
Optional API calls to fetch dynamic content on the Documentation page.
performance_metrics: Page load time for the Documentation page.
Time taken to resolve the 'Documentation' link redirection.
Time to fully render the Documentation page.
accessibility_requirements: Ensure the 'Documentation' link has an appropriate ARIA label.
Check that the link is keyboard-navigable.
Verify color contrast for the link text.
Ensure the page title is correctly set on the Documentation page.
Validate screen reader compatibility for the footer links.
